cheats.name: Infinite Fuel
cheats.description: Holds the active truck's fuel so it never drains. Enable it with a full-ish tank; it freezes fuel at whatever level it's at when you turn it on. Durable pointer chain found in-house (range-scan the fuel float, freeze, pointer-scan); verified across two relaunches.

cheats.name: No Engine Damage
cheats.description: Keeps the active truck's accumulated engine damage at zero. Found in-house by scanning increasing damage rather than decreasing integrity; verified across multiple SnowRunner relaunches.

cheats.name: No Transmission Damage
cheats.description: Keeps the active truck's accumulated transmission damage at zero. Found in-house as the engine accumulator's sibling field and confirmed by restoring 180/180 and blocking further transmission damage.

cheats.name: No Suspension Damage
cheats.description: Keeps the active truck's accumulated suspension damage at zero. Found in-house by scanning increasing damage; verified live by restoring 200/200 and across a fresh SnowRunner relaunch where the chain reported exactly 200 minus current integrity.

cheats.name: No Fuel Tank Damage
cheats.description: Keeps the active truck's accumulated fuel-tank damage at zero. Found in-house by scanning 50 minus current integrity; verified live by restoring 50/50 and across a fresh SnowRunner relaunch where the chain reported exactly 50 minus current integrity.
